# Current Windows preview

Source `19b156e2` is available as a portable ZIP, an NSIS installer and
unsigned development MSIX 34. The theme editor More menu uses aligned icons for
Import, Export and Reset in Dark and Light.

The portable app passed the native visual check. MSIX passed upgrade from
revision 32 with automatic indexing enabled, real sign-in, Explorer folder
actions and removal.

See ../WINDOWS_CANDIDATE_ACCEPTANCE.json for scope and artifact hashes.
